formula: U = E − r·I   (E f.é.m., r résistance interne)
sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic of a real battery (EMF E, internal resistance
r) driving an external variable load R. Ammeter, voltmeter across
battery terminals. Sliders: E, r, R. Live U(I) characteristic of the
generator: U = E − r·I, straight line with intercept E and slope −r.
Student varies R (from ∞ open-circuit to 0 short-circuit) and watches
the operating point slide along the line. HUD: U, I, P_delivered =
U·I, P_lost = r·I². Experiment: match a target characteristic by
picking E, r. Evaluate: characteristic hidden; student measures at
two loads (peek button) to deduce E and r analytically, then submits.
Wrinkle: internal resistance unlocks Pouillet and point de
fonctionnement.
